The '''''Victory''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It was the last command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Michael Unther]] before he retired.<ref name="WC">{{JournalCite|2|A World to Conquer}}</ref>
